label: rem:confinement-sdp-vs-lp
title: Relation of the confinement SDP to the scalar LP
html:
Remark. The scalar confinement LP restricts \Phi in the confinement SDP to the diagonal span of the NF basis \{b_i\} and drops the 2\times2 pair blocks. Equivalently, the LP is the SDP with the rank-1 restriction \Phi = \mathrm{diag}(x) and the simplification \pi_\lambda \mapsto \mathbf{1}_\lambda.

The LP is exact when every Wedderburn block is one-dimensional. In general, the LP provides a lower bound on the SDP and misses the multi-operator binding structure. For most baryonic and light-nuclear configurations, the Wedderburn decomposition has 1-dimensional blocks and the LP suffices. Magic-number and shell-closure configurations require the SDP.
